flags.missing: Gas-smell steps: the urgency of "Immediately call your gas supplier from a neighbor's phone" (keep "immediately" or "right away", and where to call from).
Turn-off steps: "Turn off all electric power to the appliance if service is to be performed."
TV above the fireplace: "If the mantel is constructed of combustible materials, make certain that the entire mantel meets the clearances to combustible mantel requirements."

A short summary (fault line or search hint) says to wait and retry/relight without the stop condition. If the manual's relight instruction includes the gas-smell check, add "if you still smell gas, stop" to the summary; if it doesn't, leave it.
